geography: World Bank countries and economies with a non-aggregate region and at least one published value in the series. Codes follow the World Bank registry, including XKX for Kosovo.
transformations: Rows are grouped under their source economy codes. All years within the observed series span appear. Null in JSON and blank in CSV represent an unavailable observation. Numeric values retain the precision returned by the publisher. Explicit zeros and status codes are retained.
validation: Each observation from the API for every non-aggregate economy, including unavailable years, was checked for equality with its entry in the separately downloaded official wide CSV release.

trade-exports.name: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
trade-exports.definition: Exports of goods includes changes in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. Exports of services includes services provided by residents to non-residents. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

trade-imports.name: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)
trade-imports.definition:
Imports of goods includes change in the economic ownership of goods from non-residents to




residents of the compiling economy, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. Imports of services includes services provided by non-residents to residents. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

methodology.source: World Bank World Development Indicators, national statistical offices, central banks and World Bank staff estimates.
methodology.measure: Annual export and import values of goods and services are expressed as a percentage of the same economy’s GDP. Goods transactions follow changes in economic ownership. Services follow provision from a resident to a nonresident for exports and the reverse for imports.
methodology.units: Each value is a percentage of GDP. Changes between years are percentage points. A share can exceed 100% because gross trade flows can exceed domestic value added. These series provide no physical volumes or constant-price amounts.
methodology.coverage: Customs and balance of payments records can differ in valuation, timing, and coverage of changes in ownership. The explorer retains each source series independently. Missing component or total observations stay unavailable.
methodology.interpretation: Exports plus imports express total trade relative to GDP. Exports less imports express the goods and services balance as a share of GDP when both components are observed. Current-account balances also include primary and secondary income.
methodology.zeroNote: Both component series and the separately published total report zero for Venezuela in 1991–2011. Use caution when interpreting those zeros as economic activity.
